purpose: Recover directly measured public monotherapy curves and test whether sparse observations can supply qualified features without exact full-curve or target-state requirements.
sources: Public Jaaks2022 original raw plate ZIP and audited existing fitted design metadata; verify local source SHA256 and current Figshare metadata. Download source only if missing or differing, into a new destination.
target_exclusion: Exclude all14 exposed repeat target SIDMs before per-plate intensity normalization, deduplication or curve aggregation. No combination-well response is used in features. No new Vis/held-out outcomes opened.
raw_measurement: Plate-local normalized mono viability=(mono intensity-blank mean)/(NC-1 mean-blank mean), unique physical POSITION, component-ambiguous mono wells quarantined, no clipping. Preserve actual tested uM and source seeding-to-read duration; drug treatment72h is method-derived separately.
QC: Require finite blank/NC-1 with >=3 unique wells each, positive NC-1-minus-blank denominator, NC-1 CV<=0.18 and Z-factor>=0.3, as documented primary-screen gates. Retain all exclusion reasons. No nonfinite/failed curve replaced by zero.
deduplication: Keep mono per plate and role; average repeated physical wells within plate, then aggregate plates within SIDM,seeding event,drug,role,dose before biological-cell aggregation. Library curves are independent of whichever anchor annotation rows repeat their measurements.
features: Exact-dose directly measured high-dose viability, observed log-dose normalized trapezoid area if >=3 distinct doses, adjacent top-dose response change per log2dose; these are observed-range summaries, not fitted pharmacological Emax or Hill slopes. Anchor mono doses remain separate and are not guessed from library top.
tiers: Exact observed dose in historical same tissue
Within-observed-range log-dose interpolation bracketed by both real measurements
Other tissue reference with explicit transport flag
Static fallback if identity, units or assay context unsupported
requirements_that_may_be_lowered: Full fitted curves need not be compulsory when endpoint has a valid single-dose observation; matched cell is not compulsory for declared public reference features; missing modalities handled by separate observation tasks and support labels. Independence and predecision availability remain required for confirmatory claims.
evaluation_now: Coverage and information-content diagnostics on fixed4519candidate menu and280static-boundary rows; optional exploratory sparse-reference ranking using prior frozen nested grid, fixed70%firstscreen,2rounds and unchanged confirmation order. No best arm promotion or redefinition of success.
dual_core: World model consumes sparse condition-qualified response evidence and returns supported response/rank estimates; agent chooses retrieval or experimental actions under actual coverage and costs. No mono viability converted to synergy or mechanism probability, no LLM gain asserted from deterministic acquisition.
preservation: Earlier imports, contracts, report/manifest bytes and stop verdicts remain unchanged. All new outputs refuse overwrite.
claims: New raw-source acquisition and qualification are engineering/data achievements. This exposed retrospective dataset is not new independent biological verification.
